- Webhook Notification
  - [Webhook Notifications](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/webhook-notifications.md)
    - [checkout created](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/checkout-created.md): Checkout page got generated successfully
    - [checkout completed](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/checkout-completed.md): Likely that the Payment was made and checkout successfully returned the user to the return urls provided. Always refer to PAYIN_COMPLETED if the payment was received by Finmo.
    - [checkout cancelled](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/checkout-cancelled.md): Checkout session was cancelled by the user
    - [checkout expired](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/checkout-expired.md): Checkout page got expired
    - [payin created](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/payin-created.md): Payment request was successful. You can create using a Hosted Checkout or a Direct API call. The status of the payment will be pending
    - [payin completed](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/payin-completed.md): Payment was made by the user. Funds got credited to one of the Finmo's bank account or it's network partners'. All your settlements are based on this
    - [payin cancelled](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/payin-cancelled.md): Payment was cancelled by the user. Typically follows after Checkout was cancelled
    - [payin expired](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/payin-expired.md): Payment instructions got expired
    - [fees payment](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/fees-payment.md): Any payment made to Fee wallet against an invoice raised by Finmo
    - [topup](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/topup.md): Any funds loaded to Payin (typically for refunds) or Payout wallet
    - [virtual account payin completed](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/va-payin-completed.md): Funds received on a static virtual account
    - [refund created](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/refund-created.md): Refund request was created
    - [refund completed](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/refund-completed.md): Refund request was completed successfully
    - [customer created](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/customer-created.md): Customer object created successfully
    - [customer updated](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/customer-updated.md): Customer object was updated. Typically when you update the details such as Address etc
    - [customer deleted](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/customer-deleted.md): Customer object is soft deleted on the platform
    - [wallet created](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/wallet-created.md): Wallet object created successfully
    - [virtual account created](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/virtual-account-created.md): Virtual Account was issued to a customer
    - [virtual account deleted](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/virtual-account-deleted.md): Virtual Account was deleted for a customer
    - [payout created](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/payout-created.md): Payout request was successful
    - [payout completed](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/payout-completed.md): Payout was processed from Finmo's end successfully. This is not an indicator of beneficiary in receipt of funds
    - [payout failed](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/payout-failed.md): Payout request failed
    - [payout returned](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/payout-returned.md): Payout got completed earlier but the funds were returned due to some reason by the beneficiary's bank
    - [wallet fund transfer completed](https://docs.finmo.net/reference/wallet-fund-transfer-completed.md): Wallet Fund Transfer Completed
